profile.headline: Staff Tax Analyst Programmer (Technical Lead, Lacerte) at Intuit | CPA, MS Taxation | 30 yrs bridging tax law & software architecture | AI-first legacy modernization
profile.summary:
I'm one of a small handful of fintech professionals who is both a CPA with an MS in Taxation and a working software architect. For 30 years in professional tax software — 27 at Intuit, I've built and modernized the tax engines behind professional tax products — the calculation logic, multi-jurisdictional compliance, and the system architecture underneath.
What I do that few others can: collapse the translation gap between regulatory requirements and production code. Tax law changes; engineers don't always understand the change; compliance experts don't always know what the engine can absorb. I sit on both sides of that gap.
In the last two years I've gone all-in on AI-augmented development, shipping at roughly 5x my previous velocity using Cursor, Claude Code, and LLM-integrated pipelines. I have filed a patent (US20230033585A1) for real-time tax impact analysis — a system that computes the actual downstream tax consequences of a proposed transaction against a taxpayer's real return before they act.
Recent work:

Built ODT Insight, an internal static-analysis tool that programmatically extracts business rules from a 25-year-old mission-critical Delphi codebase, enabling peer code review and safe migration of legacy logic into modern frameworks.
Built the tax strategy engine behind Intuit Tax Advisor — a library of planning strategies including Roth conversions, capital gains harvesting, retirement contribution optimization, entity selection, and multi-year projections with full 50-state coverage.
Architected tax engine specifications for multi-jurisdictional compliance with zero-defect deployment requirements.

Where I'm useful: any organization building tax, compliance, or estate planning software where domain depth matters as much as engineering velocity. Especially: modernizing legacy compliance systems, integrating AI into financial workflows, or scaling multi-jurisdictional tax logic.
Tech: Python, TypeScript, Object Pascal/Delphi, Java, REST/API design, static analysis, AI-integrated development tooling (Cursor, Claude Code).

positions.title: Staff Tax Analyst Programmer (Technical Lead) — Lacerte Development
positions.description:
• Set technical direction for the Lacerte tax engine across Individual, Partnership, S-Corp, Corp, and Fiduciary (1041) entity types — owning the architecture decisions and standards the rest of the team builds against.
 • Own the roadmap for AI-first modernization of the 25-year-old Delphi codebase: what legacy logic migrates, in what order, and how it's validated before it ships.
 • Set team standards for AI-assisted development, code review, and zero-defect deployment.
 • Direct and mentor a distributed US/India team on a follow-the-sun cadence.

positions.title: Senior Tax Analyst Programmer (Technical Lead) — Lacerte Development
positions.description:
• Led the Lacerte development team while staying hands-on in the codebase — architecture, complex tax logic, and code review across Individual, Partnership, S-Corp, Corp, and Fiduciary (1041) entity types.
 • Built ODT Insight, a Python/FastAPI static-analysis tool that programmatically extracts business rules from 25-year-old Delphi source files, enabling peer code review and codebase-wide defect detection across 50-state tax forms.
 • Drove adoption of AI-first workflows (Cursor, Claude Code) across the team, reaching ~5x velocity improvement on feature delivery.
 • Served as lead developer on a distributed US/India team running a follow-the-sun cadence with offshore mentorship.
positions.insights: Tax Engine Architecture & Multi-Jurisdictional Compliance, Legacy Codebase Modernization & Static Analysis and +3 skills

positions.title: Senior Tax Analyst Programmer - Intuit Tax Advisor
positions.description:
• Designed and built the tax strategy engine powering Intuit's advisory product for CPAs and EAs — a comprehensive library of planning strategies including Roth conversions, capital gains harvesting, retirement contribution optimization, entity selection, and multi-year tax projections. 
•  Translated complex IRC sections, Treasury regulations, and IRS guidance into computable strategy logic with full federal and 50-state coverage.
•Architected the strategy evaluation framework that compares pre- and post-transaction tax outcomes, enabling advisors to show clients the real dollar impact of financial decisions.
 • Sole inventor on patent US20230033585A1 — "Systems and methods of taxation analysis for asset transactions" — a real-time tax impact engine that computes downstream consequences of proposed transactions against actual taxpayer data.

positions.title: Lead Developer & Architect (Pro Bono Community Project)
positions.description:
• Led the development of the Community Resource Locator, a cross-platform application connecting vulnerable populations to essential services.  
• Integrated OpenStreetMap’s Overpass API for real-time geolocation-based search, enhancing user accessibility to nearby non-profits.  
• Designed an 'Urgent Mode' UI and a natural language chat assistant, improving user experience in high-stress situations.

positions.title: Tax Analyst Programmer
positions.description:
• Analyzed Fiduciary state tax form instructions and coded them into the Lacerte professional tax product.  
• Became the state lead after the first season, mentoring and training fellow developers.  
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and accuracy in tax software.

positions.title: Technical Support/QA
positions.description:
• Provided exceptional technical support in the tax support queue, addressing customer inquiries effectively.  
• Promoted to floor walker, resolving escalations and ensuring customer satisfaction.  
• Transitioned to the quality assurance department after seasonal product testing, enhancing product reliability.  
• Developed strong problem-solving and communication skills while working in a fast-paced environment at Lacerte Software Corporation.

patents.title: System and method for voice over IP (VoIP) support for computer-implemented processes
patents.description: Co-inventor. VoIP integration system for embedding voice support directly into tax software workflows.

patents.title: Systems and methods of taxation analysis for asset transactions
patents.description: Sole inventor. System that generates two complete tax returns — one with and one without a proposed transaction — compares them, and surfaces the real impact on total taxes owed, deductions, credits, and other downstream effects. Enables "in the moment" tax advisory before a taxpayer acts.
